observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a single-tone, slot-loading game console body consistent with an original 'fat' PS4 shape (not the two-tone slim/pro design).
A camouflage-pattern DualShock-style controller is shown resting on the console in both photos.
Photo 1 shows partial branding: 'SONY' logo on the left side and 'PS4' text visible on the right edge of the top panel.
Surface of the console shows visible dust, light scuff marks and a scratch near the left corner in photo 1.
No power-on screen, no rear port shot, no storage/game-library screen, and no box or serial plate are visible in either photo.
Only one controller is visible despite no claim of multiple pads needed, matching seller's '1 pad' statement.

response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used PS4 fat console with one controller, but none of the seller's functional or games claims can be verified from the photos, and the games list contains titles that do not exist, so it must be priced at worst case as a console-only unverified-working unit comparable to similar plain UK/London-used PS4 fat listings in Oyo.
